item.title: Show HN: I put employees inside S&P 500 market-cap bubbles
item.description: I was playing around with visualising the S&P 500 by market cap and decided to add employees to each company's bubble. What surprised me was how empty some of the biggest companies looked. Nvidia is worth $5.2 trillion but employs only 42,000 people. That's around $124 million in market cap per employee. Meanwhile, Accenture employs 814,000 people and is worth $146 billion. Each stick figure represents 10,000 employees. You can zoom in and explore individual companies. I wrote a bit more about what I found here: https://bigwhalehunting.com/blog/workforce/ Would be interested to hear what you… Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.

item.title: Presidential runoff under way in Brazil
item.description: Brazil is also heading to the polls today for a run-off vote that will decide who leads the country. The race is on a knife edge between incumbent left-wing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio scored a major upset in the first round earlier this month, taking the lead in the vote. The campaign has been dominated by corruption scandals, economic difficulties and allegations of US interference, which Washington has denied. France 24 correspondent Jan Onoszko reports the latest from Rio de Janeiro. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: After surviving cardiac arrest in 2023, Damar Hamlin helped 1,293 people learn CPR in one hour
item.description: Damar Hamlin set a Guinness World Record by successfully teaching hands-only CPR to 1,293 individuals at Acrisure Stadium.
